children: Canada mining company's Q2 revenue fell 13% yr/yr due to lower production
Production declines linked to safety improvement works at Ying Mining District
GC Mine remains suspended pending regulatory approval, expected to have minimal impact
GC Mine expected to resume production by November 2027, pending regulatory approvals
Company does not expect GC Mine suspension to materially impact overall operations or financial performance
LOWER PRODUCTION - Co said Q2 output of silver, gold, lead and zinc fell 34-51% yr/yr due to safety improvement works at Ying Mining District
HIGHER METAL PRICES - Co said higher realized prices for silver (up 82% yr/yr) and gold (up 32% yr/yr) partially offset lower production
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the non-gold precious metals & minerals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Silvercorp Metals Inc is C$21.00, about 52.4% above its October 19 closing price of C$13.78
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
